en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a curving coastal road running along rocky shores beside calm water and low hills. A 1930s-era car drives on the road, while another car is parked near a tent and people camping on the grass in the foreground. Rocky cliffs and sparse trees rise on the right; islands and shoreline are visible across the water. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and a small triangular publisher logo with a number is at the bottom right.
